# Fig S1B

Cumulative distribution of mEPSC event peak amplitudes following homeostatic plasticity.

**Source data**  
`Fig S1B.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Cell` — Cell ID
- `Peak_Amp` — Signed mEPSC peak amplitude (pA)

## Data

```{r fig-s1b-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2)
})

Events <- read_csv("./Fig S1B.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(Date = trimws(as.character(Date)), Condition = as.character(Condition),
            Cell = as.character(Cell), Peak_Amp = as.numeric(Peak_Amp)) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% c("Control", "TTX"), is.finite(Peak_Amp)) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("Control", "TTX")))

if (n_distinct(Events$Condition) != 2) stop("Both Control and TTX events are required.")
Events %>% mutate(Peak_Amp = round(Peak_Amp, 3))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-s1b-summary}
summary_table <- Events %>% group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(n_Events = n(), n_Cells = n_distinct(Date, Cell),
            n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date), .groups = "drop")
summary_table
```

## Statistics

Two-sided Kolmogorov–Smirnov test on signed event amplitudes.

```{r fig-s1b-statistics}
ks_result <- ks.test(Events$Peak_Amp[Events$Condition == "Control"],
                     Events$Peak_Amp[Events$Condition == "TTX"])
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))

stats_table <- tibble(
  Test = "Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test",
  Comparison = "Control vs TTX",
  `KS statistic (D)` = round(unname(ks_result$statistic), 4),
  `p value` = format_p(ks_result$p.value)
)
stats_table
```

## Plot

```{r fig-s1b-plot, fig.width=22, fig.height=20}
set.seed(20261109)
figs1b_plot <- ggplot(Events, aes(Peak_Amp, color = Condition)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", linewidth = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = -20, y = 0.5, label = "control",
           color = "#9E9E9E", hjust = 0, size = 30) +
  annotate("text", x = -20, y = 0.3, label = paste0("homeostatic\nplasticity", ifelse(ks_result$p.value < 0.0001,"****",ifelse(ks_result$p.value < 0.001,"***",ifelse(ks_result$p.value < 0.01,"**",ifelse(ks_result$p.value < 0.05,"*","ns"))))),
           color = "#1A1A1A", hjust = 0, size = 30) +
  scale_x_reverse(oob = scales::oob_keep, limits = c(0, -55), breaks = seq(-10, -50, by = -10),
                expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(oob = scales::oob_keep, limits = c(0, 1.03), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
                     labels = function(x) x * 100, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Control = "#9E9E9E", TTX = "#1A1A1A")) +
  labs(x = "peak amplitude (pA)", y = "% of events") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 5, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none")
figs1b_plot
```

```{r fig-s1b-save, include=FALSE}
dir.create("./Graphs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("./Graphs/Fig S1B.png", figs1b_plot, width = 22, height = 20,
       units = "in", dpi = 300)
tibble(Figure = "Fig S1B", File = "./Graphs/Fig S1B.png")
```

# Fig S1C

Mean spine area per cell following homeostatic plasticity.

**update for 2026 pending** — The analysis includes 43 treated cells. The v3 legend reports 45.

**Source data**  
`Fig S1C.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX
- `Dish` — Culture dish ID
- `Cell` — Cell ID
- `spine_area_um2` — Mean spine area per cell (µm²)

## Data

```{r fig-s1c-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2); library(ggtext)
})

spacing_map <- c(Control = 1, TTX = 2.2)
spine_df <- read_csv("./Fig S1C.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(Date, Condition, Dish, Cell, spine_area_um2) %>%
  mutate(Condition = trimws(as.character(Condition)),
         Condition = case_when(grepl("^Control", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
                               grepl("^TTX", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TTX",
                               TRUE ~ Condition),
         Date = trimws(as.character(Date)),
         spine_area_um2 = as.numeric(spine_area_um2)) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% names(spacing_map), Date != "", is.finite(spine_area_um2)) %>%
  mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = names(spacing_map)),
         Date = factor(Date), Date_Condition = paste(Condition, Date, sep = "_"),
         x_pos = unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]))

if (n_distinct(spine_df$Condition) < 2 || n_distinct(spine_df$Date) < 2)
  stop("Both conditions and at least two dates are required.")

spine_df %>%
  select(Date, Condition, Dish, Cell, spine_area_um2) %>%
  mutate(spine_area_um2 = round(spine_area_um2, 3))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-s1c-summary}
summary_table <- spine_df %>% group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(n_Cells = n_distinct(Date, Dish, Cell), n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date),
            `Mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(spine_area_um2),
                                  sd(spine_area_um2) / sqrt(n())), .groups = "drop")
summary_table
```

## Statistics

Two-way ANOVA with condition, experiment date, and their interaction (Type I sums of squares).

```{r fig-s1c-statistics}
fit_aov <- aov(spine_area_um2 ~ Condition * Date, data = spine_df)
condition_p <- as.numeric(anova(fit_aov)["Condition", "Pr(>F)"])
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))

stats_table <- tibble(
  Test = "Two-way ANOVA", Comparison = "Control vs TTX",
  `Control mean (SE)` = summary_table$`Mean (SE)`[summary_table$Condition == "Control"],
  `TTX mean (SE)` = summary_table$`Mean (SE)`[summary_table$Condition == "TTX"],
  `Condition p` = format_p(condition_p)
)
stats_table

anova(fit_aov)
```

## Plot

```{r fig-s1c-plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=20}
set.seed(20261109)
date_levels <- levels(spine_df$Date)
date_colors <- c(
  setNames(rep(c("#999999", "#E0E0E0", "#C8C8C8"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("Control", date_levels, sep = "_")),
  setNames(rep(c("#000000", "#606060", "#303030"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("TTX", date_levels, sep = "_"))
)

test_results <- tibble(
  group1_x = spacing_map["Control"], group2_x = spacing_map["TTX"],
  y_position = 0.8,
  stars = case_when(condition_p < 0.001 ~ "***", condition_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                    condition_p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns")
)

figs1c_plot <- ggplot(spine_df, aes(x_pos, spine_area_um2, color = Date_Condition)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(cex = 5, priority = "random", size = 20, corral = "random") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = x_pos), fill = NA, width = 1, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = x_pos), fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 15, size = 20, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = test_results,
               aes(x = group1_x, xend = group2_x, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = test_results,
            aes(x = (group1_x + group2_x) / 2, y = y_position + 0.02, label = stars),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 25, color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unname(spacing_map),
                     labels = c("control", "homeostatic\nplasticity")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = date_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(oob = scales::oob_keep, breaks = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8),
                     limits = c(0.2, 0.85), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "mean spine area (&micro;m<sup>2</sup>)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 80, color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 5, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none")
figs1c_plot
```

```{r fig-s1c-save, include=FALSE}
dir.create("./Graphs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("./Graphs/Fig S1C.png", figs1c_plot, width = 18, height = 20,
       units = "in", dpi = 300)
tibble(Figure = "Fig S1C", File = "./Graphs/Fig S1C.png")
```

# Fig S1D

# Fig S1F

Dendritic mitochondrial length with imaging performed in the continued presence of TTX.

**Source data**  
`Fig S1F, G.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX with TTX maintained during imaging
- `Cell` — Cell ID
- `mean_mito_len` — Mean mitochondrial length per cell (µm)

## Data

```{r fig-s1f-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2); library(ggbeeswarm); library(ggtext)
})

spacing_map <- c(Control = 1, TTXinTTX = 2.2)
mito_df <- read_csv("./Fig S1F, G.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(Date, Condition, Cell, mean_mito_len) %>%
  mutate(Date = trimws(as.character(Date)), Condition = trimws(as.character(Condition)),
         Condition = case_when(grepl("^Control", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
                               grepl("^TTXinTTX", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TTXinTTX",
                               TRUE ~ Condition),
         mean_mito_len = as.numeric(mean_mito_len)) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% names(spacing_map), Date != "", !is.na(Cell),
         is.finite(mean_mito_len)) %>%
  mutate(Date = factor(Date), Condition = factor(Condition, levels = names(spacing_map)),
         Date_Condition = paste(Condition, Date, sep = "_"),
         x_pos = unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]))

if (n_distinct(mito_df$Condition) < 2 || n_distinct(mito_df$Date) < 2)
  stop("Both conditions and at least two dates are required.")

mito_df %>% select(Date, Condition, Cell, mean_mito_len) %>%
  mutate(mean_mito_len = round(mean_mito_len, 3))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-s1f-summary}
summary_table <- mito_df %>% group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(n_Cells = n_distinct(Date, Cell), n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date),
            `Mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(mean_mito_len),
                                  sd(mean_mito_len) / sqrt(n())), .groups = "drop")
summary_table
```

## Statistics

Two-way ANOVA with condition, experiment date, and their interaction (Type I sums of squares).

```{r fig-s1f-statistics}
fit_aov <- aov(mean_mito_len ~ Condition * Date, data = mito_df)
condition_p <- as.numeric(anova(fit_aov)["Condition", "Pr(>F)"])
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))

stats_table <- tibble(
  Test = "Two-way ANOVA", Comparison = "Control vs TTXinTTX",
  `Control mean (SE)` = summary_table$`Mean (SE)`[summary_table$Condition == "Control"],
  `TTXinTTX mean (SE)` = summary_table$`Mean (SE)`[summary_table$Condition == "TTXinTTX"],
  `Condition p` = format_p(condition_p)
)
stats_table

anova(fit_aov)
```

## Plot

```{r fig-s1f-plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=20}
set.seed(20261109)
date_levels <- levels(mito_df$Date)
date_colors <- c(
  setNames(rep(c("#4D4D4D", "#777B7E", "#1A1A1A"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("Control", date_levels, sep = "_")),
  setNames(rep(c("#00DC00", "#009A00", "#66FF66"), length.out = length(date_levels)),
           paste("TTXinTTX", date_levels, sep = "_"))
)
test_results <- tibble(
  group1_x = spacing_map["Control"], group2_x = spacing_map["TTXinTTX"],
  y_position = 12.5,
  stars = case_when(condition_p < 0.001 ~ "***", condition_p < 0.01 ~ "**",
                    condition_p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns")
) %>% filter(stars != "ns")

figs1f_plot <- ggplot(mito_df, aes(x_pos, mean_mito_len, color = Date_Condition)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(cex = 5, priority = "random", size = 20, corral = "random") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = x_pos), fill = NA, width = 1, outlier.shape = NA,
               linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(aes(group = x_pos), fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 15, size = 20, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(data = test_results,
               aes(x = group1_x, xend = group2_x, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = test_results,
            aes(x = (group1_x + group2_x) / 2, y = y_position + 0.3, label = stars),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 25, color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unname(spacing_map),
                     labels = c("control", "homeostatic\nplasticity\n(in TTX)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = date_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(oob = scales::oob_keep, breaks = c(4, 6, 8, 10, 12),
                     limits = c(3, 13.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "mito length (&micro;m)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 80, color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 80, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 5, color = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 2, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none")
figs1f_plot
```

# Fig S1G

Juxtaspinal mitochondrial area with imaging performed in the continued presence of TTX.

**Source data**  
`Fig S1F, G.csv`

**Columns**

- `Date` — Experiment date
- `Condition` — Control or TTX with TTX maintained during imaging
- `Cell` — Cell ID
- `mean_mito` — Mean juxtaspinal mitochondrial area per cell (µm²)

## Data

```{r fig-s1g-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2); library(ggbeeswarm); library(ggtext)
})

spacing_map <- c(Control = 1, TTXinTTX = 2.2)
mito_df <- read_csv("./Fig S1F, G.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(Date, Condition, Cell, mean_mito) %>%
  mutate(Date = trimws(as.character(Date)), Condition = trimws(as.character(Condition)),
         Condition = case_when(grepl("^Control", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
                               grepl("^TTXinTTX", Condition, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TTXinTTX",
                               TRUE ~ Condition),
         mean_mito = as.numeric(mean_mito)) %>%
  filter(Condition %in% names(spacing_map), Date != "", !is.na(Cell),
         is.finite(mean_mito)) %>%
  mutate(Date = factor(Date), Condition = factor(Condition, levels = names(spacing_map)),
         Date_Condition = paste(Condition, Date, sep = "_"),
         x_pos = unname(spacing_map[as.character(Condition)]))

if (n_distinct(mito_df$Condition) < 2 || n_distinct(mito_df$Date) < 2)
  stop("Both conditions and at least two dates are required.")

mito_df %>% select(Date, Condition, Cell, mean_mito) %>%
  mutate(mean_mito = round(mean_mito, 3))
```

## Summary

```{r fig-s1g-summary}
summary_table <- mito_df %>% group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(n_Cells = n_distinct(Date, Cell), n_Experiment_Dates = n_distinct(Date),
            `Mean (SE)` = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(mean_mito),
                                  sd(mean_mito) / sqrt(n())), .groups = "drop")
summary_table
```

Two-way ANOVA with condition, experiment date, and their interaction (Type I sums of squares).

```{r fig-s1g-statistics}

condition_p <- as.numeric(anova(fit_aov)["Condition", "Pr(>F)"])
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", p))

stats_table <- tibble(
  Test = "Two-way ANOVA", Comparison = "Control vs TTXinTTX",
  `Control mean (SE)` = summary_table$`Mean (SE)`[summary_table$Condition == "Control"],
  `TTXinTTX mean (SE)` = summary_table$`Mean (SE)`[summary_table$Condition == "TTXinTTX"],

)
```

# Fig S1M

Static morphological signatures of juxtaspinal mitochondrial enlargement in somatosensory cortex.

**Source data**  
`Fig S1M.csv`

**Columns**

- `Morphology` — Recruitment, protrusion, budding, or no change
- `synapses` — Synapse count in the category
- `total_synapses` — Total synapse count

## Data

```{r fig-s1m-data}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(readr); library(ggplot2)
})

category_order <- c("recruitment", "protrusion", "budding", "no change")
Pie <- read_csv("./Fig S1M.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(Category = trimws(tolower(Morphology)),
            Value = as.numeric(synapses),
            total_synapses = as.numeric(total_synapses))

if (nrow(Pie) != 4 || anyDuplicated(Pie$Category) ||
    !setequal(Pie$Category, category_order))
  stop("Fig S1M.csv must contain each of the four morphology categories once.")
if (any(!is.finite(Pie$Value)) || n_distinct(Pie$total_synapses) != 1 ||
    sum(Pie$Value) != Pie$total_synapses[1])
  stop("Synapse counts must sum to the shared total_synapses value.")

Pie <- Pie %>%
  mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = category_order)) %>%
  arrange(Category) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(100 * Value / total_synapses),
         midpoint = cumsum(Value) - Value / 2)

Pie %>% select(Category, Value, total_synapses, Percent)
```

## Summary

```{r fig-s1m-summary}
summary_table <- Pie %>% select(Category, Percent)
summary_table
```

## Statistics

Descriptive counts and percentages.

## Plot

```{r fig-s1m-plot, fig.width=20, fig.height=20}
set.seed(20261109)
fill_colors <- c(recruitment = "#66FF66", protrusion = "#00DC00",
                 budding = "#009A00", `no change` = "#BDBDBD")
start_angle <- -2 * pi * Pie$Value[Pie$Category == "recruitment"] / sum(Pie$Value)

pie_labels <- Pie %>% mutate(
  percent_x = case_when(Category == "recruitment" ~ 1.25,
                        Category == "protrusion" ~ 1.35,
                        Category == "budding" ~ 1.63, TRUE ~ 1),
  category_y = case_when(
    Category == "recruitment" ~ midpoint - 0.025 * sum(Value),
    Category == "protrusion" ~ midpoint - 0.015 * sum(Value),
    Category == "budding" ~ midpoint + 0.05 * sum(Value),
    TRUE ~ midpoint
  )
)

figs1m_plot <- ggplot(Pie, aes(x = 1, y = Value, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, linewidth = 0, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
           show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = pie_labels,
            aes(x = percent_x, y = midpoint, label = paste0(Percent, "%")),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 18, color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = pie_labels,
            aes(x = 1.95, y = category_y, label = as.character(Category)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 13, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(oob = scales::oob_keep, limits = c(0.5, 2.15), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", start = start_angle, direction = 1, clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(40, 80, 40, 80))
figs1m_plot
```

```{r fig-s1m-save, include=FALSE}
dir.create("./Graphs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("./Graphs/Fig S1M.png", figs1m_plot, width = 20, height = 20,
       units = "in", dpi = 300)
tibble(Figure = "Fig S1M", File = "./Graphs/Fig S1M.png")
```
